too young to have satisfied or failed the sustain window (right-censored)
reached ≥ $300k, alive, neither held $1M nor collapsed — undecided
reached ≥ $300k (or held ≥ $1M a week, then collapsed), now below 25% of its held-peak
7 days+ old, never reached $300k, still has a market
